purpose: owner authorization instrument template: a contracting human (legal entity) authorizes a specific agent/node to act within the TDCA protocol configuration network

scene_constraints.semantics: authorization reaches only the listed scenes of attribution; unlisted scenes are out of scope; acting beyond scenes is unauthorized

labels.utility_right: 效用权（场景效用函数调用权）
labels.configuration_right: 配置权（L2 配置权市场层）
labels.nca_nested_cognitive_asset: NCA 嵌套认知资产（调用即存证）
labels.mou_tax_anchored_voucher: MOU 税收锚定凭证（进项+出项）
labels.cross_scene_configuration_profile: 跨场景配置画像（多场景偏态档案）

five_tier_asset_forms.unlisted_tiers: may not be claimed under this instrument

full_composition_authorized.semantics: authorization covers the full composition of listed assets in listed scenes; no undisclosed reservation, hidden deduction, or additional restriction
full_composition_authorized.reservation_handling: any reservation must be explicitly listed; a reservation fails the full-composition requirement and is treated as unauthorized

legal_entity_signature.attestation: signature event attested on NCA chain, verifiable on-chain

admission_linkage.config_call_gate: configuration-type calls require a valid instrument; revoked or defective instruments are rejected fail-closed
admission_linkage.sub_authorization_chain: every layer must hold a valid instrument; any failed link invalidates all downstream links

negative_space.no_transfer: the negative space does not transfer with authorization; fundamental negative space is an absolute boundary

revocation.revoked_by: legal entity (human) personally, signed revocation statement
revocation.effect_on_history: historical attestations retained (attestation chain not deleted upon deregistration)

termination: instrument terminates automatically when the authorized party identity is TERMINATED (node-level)
effect_disclaimer: internal protocol-layer authorization only; no external legal instrument; no administrative license, official qualification, regulatory recognition, or government endorsement

clauses.key: authorization void unless all four elements complete; fail-closed
scene constraints / five-tier asset forms / full composition / legal-entity signature; agent proxy signing, holding, filling forbidden
owner_auth reference machine-verified; config calls gated; sub-authorization chain cascades
REAL/SIMULATED labeling; NCA attestation on every reference
negative space does not transfer; fail-closed
personal signed revocation; history retained; auto-terminate on node TERMINATED
fields map one-to-one with four elements; human text prevails; missing/empty/out-of-enum fails
